title: Of the Rotwood
author: Grovewarden Saevia Ilvareth
pages: A wood can sicken as a body sickens. We call it the Rotwood. It begins with grey leaves in summer and fungus on living trunks, and birds that stop singing although nothing hunts them.
Then the paths begin to loop. You walk out at the same stone you walked in by. Webs over the paths, deer wrapped in silk: the weavers have come. Do not cut through. Go round.
Rot comes from three wounds: the Hush seeping up from below, the unburied dead lying in the leaves, and the greed of those who take from the wood and never give back. Heal the wound, heal the wood.
To cleanse it: find the heart-tree, the oldest and sickest at its centre. Fell it and burn it with blessed fire. Bury every bone you find with proper rites. Replant with seed blessed at Greenvow.
Do not do this alone. Do not do it at night. And if a Grovewarden offers to do it for you and asks nothing in return, ask who taught them. Some of us have gone over to the rot.
